stem: After a procedure, the team conducts a structured debrief. What is the primary purpose of this TeamSTEPPS activity?

options.A: Establish team membership, roles, goals, and the care plan before the procedure begins.
options.B: Re-establish situational awareness and modify the care plan during an evolving clinical situation.
options.C: Verify that a specific communicated message was heard and understood correctly through closed-loop communication.
options.D: Review what occurred, identify what worked and what did not, reinforce successes, and use lessons learned to improve future team performance.

rationale: AHRQ TeamSTEPPS defines a debrief as a post-event review focused on recounting key events, analyzing what worked and what did not, identifying lessons learned, reinforcing successful behaviors, and improving the plan for future cases. Therefore D is correct. A describes a brief, B describes a huddle, and C describes a check-back rather than a debrief.
educational_objective: Use a TeamSTEPPS debrief after a clinical event to review team performance, identify lessons, reinforce effective behaviors, and plan improvements for future care.
source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)
source_document_title: TeamSTEPPS 3.0 — Reviewing the Team's Performance: Debrief
source_version_date: Page last reviewed December 2023; current TeamSTEPPS 3.0 content rechecked 2026-08-17
source_locator: Debriefs include: accurate recounting/documentation of key events; analysis of why the event occurred and what worked/did not work; lessons learned and future plan changes; reinforcement of what went well; focus on performance improvement; Team Leadership module definitions of brief/huddle/debrief
source_claim_supported: TeamSTEPPS debriefs are post-event performance-improvement reviews that examine key events, successes, problems, lessons learned, and changes for future cases; briefs are pre-care planning, huddles reassess the plan during care, and check-backs verify communicated information.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Management of Care, printed p.7/PDF p.11: Collaborate with members of the interprofessional health care team to facilitate client care; Participate in client care coordination; Participate in performance improvement activities
blueprint_topic: Management of Care — team debriefing and performance improvement
correction_summary: Retained debrief as the tested construct but replaced three punitive/administrative straw-man distractors with genuine TeamSTEPPS alternatives: brief, huddle, and check-back. This makes the item a clean discrimination among teamwork tools and reduces difficulty from hard to easy.
